title: Siam Cement makes offer to buy Thai Pride Cement
summary: Siam Cement makes offer to buy Thai Pride Cement
body_markdown:
**Thailand:** Siam Cement has made a binding offer to buy a 100% stake of the issued and paid-up shares in Thai Pride Cement **** for around US$80m. It plans to buy a 50% stake in Thai Pride Cement as soon as possible and then buy the second half by the end of 2027. The first transaction will be subject to relevant conditions, including approval from the board of directors and shareholders of the parent company of Thai Pride Cement. The second transaction will be subject to due diligence and regulatory approval. The binding offer remains valid until the end of February 2027. However, neither party will be obligated to complete the transaction until a definitive share purchase agreement has been formally agreed.


Siam Cement said that it, “…believes that the investment in Thai Pride Cement has the potential to strengthen and enhance the efficiency of its cement business.” It also noted that Thai Pride Cement’s production capacity and strategic location are well suited to supporting the expansion of low- carbon cement production, particularly Limestone Calcined Clay Cement (LC3).


Thai Pride Cement operates a 1Mt/yr integrated plant at Kahengkhoi in Saraburi. The company opened the plant in 2006.
